notes: The dash-enclosed «قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا» and «واللفظ، لابن المثنى» are editor glosses on the verbs and wording; left out.
«قال سمعت رسول الله» is Umar's own report of the Prophet, so Umar is the last link (rule 6); Uways and his questioners are in the scene only.
«أبي» is the father of «معاذ بن هشام» (relation, rule 7); not identified by the reader.
